title: VulnReport
description: Documentation Agent -> human approval gate (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §2/§3(4)): structured vulnerability report. Critical severity forces requires_human_gate=true, backing 'nothing critical self-publishes.'

recording_ref.description: Optional (issue #77/P3.36). Directory under evals/recordings/ (trailing slash, no filename) containing the committed, replayable draw(s) that back this report -- the report's own pointer to its evidence, so a reader does not have to cross-reference docs/ATO_EVIDENCE_PACKET.md §5.2 to find it. Deliberately a directory, not a single draw file: build_vuln_report() derives it from the source exploit_record's OWN recording_ref (the immediate parent directory of the file it points at), NOT from case_id -- a live campaign's category_random/mutation_of attempts can record under a fabricated id that diverges from the exploit record's case_id, so re-deriving from case_id alone can silently point at the wrong directory (cold-review FIX 1, issue #77 follow-up; see redteam/agents/documentation.py::_recording_ref_for). The single-segment charset is deliberately narrow (lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens, matching every real case_id in this repo) rather than the more permissive '[^/]+' a first pass used -- exploit_record.schema.json's own case_id has no character-restricting pattern (only minLength:1), so a wider charset here would let a case_id of e.g. '..' produce a schema-valid recording_ref ('evals/recordings/../') that resolves OUTSIDE evals/recordings/ entirely (sec-audit, issue #77 review). This charset structurally excludes '.', so '..' can never validate. The trailing anchor is '\Z', not '$' -- jsonschema's Draft202012Validator runs Python's re.search, under which '$' also matches immediately before a trailing '\n', so a value ending '.../\n' would validate under '$' but is rejected under '\Z'. Not reachable today (no caller appends a trailing newline and no traversal is achievable either way), but keep '\Z' here -- a later editor loosening this back to '$' would reopen exactly the anchor gap this comment exists to prevent.
